exterior.summary: Form and roof are readable; repetitive window openings remain dark flat recesses.

materials.summary: Brick scale/corner continuity read well; mortar is graphic and glazing reads opaque.

interior.summary: Plan overview is improved but core is hard to resolve; classroom is sparsely furnished; atrium lacks legible circulation and visible rails.

technical.summary: Blender 5.2.3 reopen: 722 objects, 714 meshes, no missing images, identity unparented root; Plan1086 edge remains uncertain.

evidence.summary: 2024 plan and historical atrium sources support broad arrangement/character; current finishes, circulation, and facade specifics remain unverified.

findings.issue: North glazing reveal fit is unverified; saved +0.60m Y offset does not visibly fix glazing in full exterior/closeup and may cause protrusion.
Whole-floor plan cutaway is a useful improvement, but the core cluster and door gaps remain too small/low-contrast for detailed validation.
Atrium section exposes four levels but does not clearly show guardrail glass, stair, bridge, or circulation.
Plan1086 wall remains an unresolved boundary flag: 2.10m bbox-corner overhang and 1.27m centroid offset under approximate 1–2m registration uncertainty.

limitations: No reproducible Google Maps facade screenshot is preserved.
